title: 卡帶轉啊轉
subject: a long-haul truck driver on the Sichuan-Tibet highway whose only cassette was chewed by the deck, winds it back with a pencil at every rest stop, and now the song wobbles and he sings along with the wobble
caption: Tibetan-inflected dranyen folk-pop, bouncing 4/4 dance-folk groove with a high-plateau highway setting. dranyen lute strummed in bouncing triplet-flavoured eighths with ringing open strings, a goblet drum and a Tibetan hand frame drum keeping a rolling pulse, a cello holding a low sustained drone, a high bamboo flute doubling the hook. warm live-room acoustic mix with wide natural reverb, no electronic bass, handclaps on the off-beats. male lead, bright baritone with relaxed open-throat folk delivery, clearly sung, short call-style hook. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 112 BPM, A minor. wry, breezy, danceable mood. No rap, no autotune, no electronic drums, no synth bass, no throat-singing growls, no EDM drop.
lyrics:
[Intro - dranyen and hand drum]

[Verse 1]
高原公路 一條線
卡帶吃進去 吐出一團黑
鉛筆插進孔 轉一轉
歌又回來了 慢了半拍

[Pre-Chorus]
我在休息站 轉啊轉
太陽曬著 方向盤

[Chorus]
卡帶轉啊轉 歌也搖啊搖
唱到一半 它自己晃
我也晃 方向盤跟著晃
卡帶轉啊轉 一路唱回家

[Verse 2]
老闆說 買新的吧
我說 這捲 我聽了十年
壞了一個地方 剛好是副歌
我就跟著 壞的那邊唱

[Chorus]
卡帶轉啊轉 歌也搖啊搖
唱到一半 它自己晃
我也晃 方向盤跟著晃
卡帶轉啊轉 一路唱到山口

[Bridge - dranyen and flute alone]
鉛筆短了 再削一削
削下來的木屑 吹給風

[Chorus]
卡帶轉啊轉 歌也搖啊搖
唱到一半 它自己晃
我也晃 全車的人都晃
卡帶轉啊轉 一路唱回家

[Outro - flute and dranyen, fading]
下個休息站 再轉一圈
